entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I don't think it's working right. I think I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely look into that for you. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's definitely a fault. It's just not working. I've charged it and everything, but it won't sync with the app on my phone. I feel like the device is just broken.
I see. A device that won't sync is certainly no good. Let me pull up your account details. Can I get your full name please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. I'm just so confused by all of this. The website said it would be easy. Can't you just help me? Maybe I should send it back.

I understand your frustration, Sarah. I've got your account here. I see the VeloBand was delivered 14 days ago. Since the band seems to be defective, the correct next step is to get you over to our Technical Support team.
Technical support? Oh, I don't know... I'm not very good with technical things. Are you sure you can't just take it back? It seems easier.

I completely understand wanting a simple solution. Our tech team is the best and fastest way to get you one. They have advanced tools to figure out why it won't sync and can often fix it right over the phone. If they find the hardware is truly broken, they can authorize a warranty replacement for you immediately.
Oh. So they could send me a new one if this one is defective?

Exactly. They'll run a few tests with you, and if it's confirmed as a fault, they'll handle the replacement process right away. This is our standard procedure for any device that's not working correctly. Would you be comfortable with me transferring you to them now?
Okay... yes. If they can figure it out or send me a new one, that would be great. I just want it to work. Thank you.
Of course, Sarah. I'm happy to help get this sorted out for you. Please stay on the line, and I'll connect you to Technical Support right now.
